pieces.Text: A thrasfyr can control the six chains that hang from its body as if they were its own limbs.  As a standard action, it can cause these chains to snake outward to a radius of 30 feet.  All creatures in this area take 10d6 points of slashing damage and become entangled - a DC
Reflex save halves the damage and negates the entangled condition.  An entangled creature can escape with a DC

Reflex save or a DC 30 Escape Artist check made as a full-round action.  The chains can also be sundered (hardness 10, hp 20, Break DC 28).  The thrasfyr creates these chains from its own body - destroyed chains regrow in 24 hours.
